name: Buzz-Bee
source:
Occupation: Candy seller.

Skills/Abilities: He has a high-pitched voice that can be heard from miles.

Notes: He is cheerful and always smiling. A very innocent type who would never suspect me.
I know he likes sweets because I saw him eating half of the candy he sells. 
People in the town don't appreciate his yelling.
